bio.text: Tom Perriello won the Democratic nomination in Virginia's 5th Congressional District in August 2026, according to the Associated Press.
He previously represented the 5th District in Congress from 2009 to 2011, after defeating Rep. Virgil Goode in 2008, and lost the seat in 2010.

Perriello later led U.S. Programs at the Open Society Foundations, was U.S. Special Envoy for the Great Lakes Region of Africa from 2015 to 2016, and was U.S. Special Envoy for Sudan from February 2024 until he resigned in January 2025.
He lost the 2017 Democratic primary for governor to Ralph Northam.

sources.title: Perriello mounts comeback bid in Virginia's 5th District
